:::{#def-cind-continuous}
#### Conditional independence given a continuous random vector

[Random variables](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $\dsn{Y}$ are **conditionally independent given a continuous random vector** $\vX$ <!-- check-term-links: allow: the bold phrase is the defined term itself -->
(compare [conditional independence given a discrete random vector](#def-cind))
if, for every $\vx$ with $\p(\vX = \vx) > 0$ and all $\dsn{y}$:

$$\frac{\p(\vX = \vx, Y_1 = y_1, \ldots, Y_n = y_n)}{\p(\vX = \vx)} = \prodin{\frac{\p(\vX = \vx, Y_i = y_i)}{\p(\vX = \vx)}}$$

where each $\p(\cdot)$ is a [joint density](random-variables.qmd#def-joint-pdf)
(with probability masses in place of densities for any discrete $Y_i$,
as in a [joint density-mass function](random-variables.qmd#def-joint-density-mass)).

:::
